description:
£200 PPPW - My Property Box are delighted to welcome to the market this beautiful, fully furnished eight bedroom, eight bath student house, situated on the highly sought-after Osborne Road in Jesmond.

Ideally located to take full advantage of Jesmond-s fantastic range of amenities, the property is perfectly suited to student living, with popular bars, restaurants, cafés and local shops all close by.

The property comprises eight spacious bedrooms, a large communal living room and a well-equipped kitchen, providing plenty of space for socialising and relaxing. Additional benefits include a separate utility area and multiple bathrooms and en-suites for added convenience.

Early viewing is highly recommended, as this fantastic student property is sure to attract plenty of interest! Contact My Property Box today and speak to our lettings team to arrange your viewing.
